author: bajaj_auto
title: Chetak electric scooter festive launch
body: New Chetak EV scooter launching this Dhanteras at all dealerships, bookings open with a ₹2,000 token.

author: hdfc_bank
title: RBI holds repo rate at 6.5%
body: RBI's monetary policy committee kept the repo rate unchanged at 6.5%; loan EMIs stay flat this quarter.

author: flipkart
title: Big Billion Days dates announced
body: Big Billion Days sale runs Oct 1-8 with deals on smartphones, TVs and fashion. Looking for bank partners for instant discounts.

author: makemytrip
title: Holiday flight sale
body: Flat 15% off on domestic flights and hotels for the December holiday season.

author: phonepe
title: NPCI raises UPI limit
body: NPCI raised the UPI per-transaction limit for tax payments and hospitals to ₹5 lakh from next month.

author: croma
title: iPhone launch day stock
body: Croma stores will stock the new iPhone from launch day; we are looking for card partners for no-cost EMI.

author: delhivery
title: Express delivery to 2,000 new pin codes
body: Delhivery now offers next-day express shipping to 2,000 new pin codes across tier-3 towns.

author: tata_aig
title: Two-wheeler insurance bundle
body: Tata AIG offers first-year motor insurance at 20% off when bundled with new two-wheeler purchases at dealerships.

author: zomato
title: Restaurant commission update
body: Zomato is reducing restaurant commission for cloud kitchens in 10 cities.

author: swiggy
title: Instamart 10-minute grocery in Pune
body: Instamart launches 10-minute grocery delivery across Pune with free delivery on the first three orders.

author: paytm_money
title: SEBI tightens F&O rules
body: SEBI tightened futures and options rules for retail traders, effective next quarter.
